## Scope and source notes

Six downloaded archives contain one CAMT052 example for Sweden and five CAMT053 examples for Sweden/UK, including incoming/outgoing payments and Swish ecommerce. All target namespaces are version02. Archive/member hashes are recorded in source-inventory.json. No open redistribution licence established; public access alone does not grant permission to republish fixtures.
